scripts.validate: npm run build && npm run check:links
scripts.deploy: npm run validate && npm run deploy:preview:upload && npm run deploy:production:upload
scripts.deploy:production: npm run validate && npm run deploy:production:upload
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run validate && npm run deploy:preview:upload
scripts.deploy:production:upload: npx --yes wrangler@4.122.0 pages deploy dist --project-name splinterm-coming-soon --branch main
scripts.deploy:preview:upload: npx --yes wrangler@4.122.0 pages deploy dist --project-name splinterm-preview --branch main
